page_title: UNI 2-1 MAI | Union Berlin v Mainz 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Mainz are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
87' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
86' The foul by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Exner.
85' Benedict Hollerbach comes off the pitch to be replaced by Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
85' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) replacing Robert Skov.
84' Substitution. Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Phillipp Mwene walks off.
84' The attendance is 21000.
84' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Paul Nebel (Mainz).
82' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) makes a slide tackle, but referee Florian Exner blows for a foul. Mainz are awarded a free kick.

81' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. It's a free kick to Mainz, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
79' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
78' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefan Bell leaves the pitch and Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) comes on.
75' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

75' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

74' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florian Exner with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick to Union Berlin.
74' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Andras Schafer.
68' PENALTY APPEAL after Nelson Weiper (Mainz) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
67' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' The ball possession at the moment is 33:67.
61' Michael Silberbauer prepares a substitution. Danny da Costa is replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
61' Substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) on for Armindo Sieb.
61' It's time for a substitution. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) comes on in place of Anthony Caci.
61' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' Here is a change. Jordan Siebatcheu is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
60' Substitution. Josip Juranovic walks off the pitch and Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.

60' A short pass finds Robert Skov (Union Berlin). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
57' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
56' Mainz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
51' The foul by Armindo Sieb (Mainz) was seen by Florian Exner who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Union Berlin.
47' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The whistle blows and Florian Exner starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' A pass from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is intercepted by Alexander Schwolow and the move breaks down.
43' Anthony Caci (Mainz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
41' The Mainz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
35' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) takes the corner which is cleared.
32' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card for infringement.
32' Today's referee Florian Exner rightly decides to book Stefan Bell (Mainz) for his harsh tackle.
31' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
30' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
29' Anthony Caci (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
26' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florian Exner ignores the protests.
24' 2 - 1 Goal! Robert Skov (Union Berlin) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Robin Zentner into the bottom right corner.
24' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
24' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) jumps into a tackle and Florian Exner signals a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Union Berlin!
21' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:3.

15' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

11' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Armindo Sieb (Mainz) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.

9' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom left corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

9' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner pulls off a great save to deny him.
7' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
5' 1 - 1 Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alexander Schwolow into the bottom left corner.
5' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is going to take the penalty!

4' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul. Mainz are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Union Berlin will take the kick-off.
Florian Exner got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
